findings.name: DecreaseCriticalCnt no lower bound — integer underflow
findings.source_evidence: critical_handler.cpp:48-56: g_count declared as int32_t, decremented unconditionally without lower bound check. g_count == 0 branch only handles zero, not negative values. Underflow carries correction.
counter_evidence_checked: No lower bound check before decrement
findings.mitigation: Add lower bound check: if (g_count <= 0) return; before decrement

findings.name: Seed value not zeroed before free in identity_group.c
findings.source_evidence: identity_group.c:552,559,565: HcFree(seedVal) called at three locations without prior secure zeroization. ClearFreeUint8Buff exists in codebase but not used here.
findings.mitigation: Call memset_s(seedVal, SEED_LEN, 0, SEED_LEN) before HcFree(seedVal)

findings.name: Account-related group membership bypass
findings.source_evidence: group_auth_data_operation.c:187: For AUTH_FORM_ACROSS_ACCOUNT and AUTH_FORM_IDENTICAL_ACCOUNT, device membership check returns true unconditionally. P2P groups DO verify properly.
findings.mitigation: Add proper device membership verification for account-related groups

findings.name: Credential listener callback invoked under mutex — re-entrancy deadlock
findings.source_evidence: cred_listener.c:47,68,89: LockHcMutex acquired before invoking external callbacks. If callback re-enters device_auth API that acquires same mutex, deadlock occurs.
counter_evidence_checked: External callbacks are unknown third-party code
findings.mitigation: Release mutex before invoking external callbacks, or use recursive mutex

findings.name: Task queue has no capacity limit — unbounded growth
findings.source_evidence: hc_task_thread.c:40-55: PushTask appends to task vector via pushBack without checking current size or enforcing capacity limit.
findings.mitigation: Add MAX_TASK_QUEUE_SIZE limit with rejection when full

findings.name: Global session slots have no per-source limit — single source exhaustion
findings.source_evidence: dev_session_mgr.c:86-101: Session creation checks curSessionNum against MAX_AUTH_SESSION_COUNT=10 globally. Single caller can exhaust all 10 slots.
counter_evidence_checked: No per-UID or per-appId counter exists
findings.mitigation: Add per-UID session cap alongside global limit

findings.name: Credential ID generated with timestamp — predictable identifier
findings.source_evidence: identity_operation.c:87: credId generation uses HcGetCurTimeInMillis() timestamp without random component — predictable within millisecond window
counter_evidence_checked: No random component added to credId
findings.mitigation: Add random suffix to credential ID generation

findings.name: Shared key material in malloc buffer not zeroed after use
findings.source_evidence: device_auth.c:1134-1146: sharedKeyVal allocated via HcMalloc filled with session key bytes, freed at line 1141 without secure zeroization
counter_evidence_checked: HcFree calls free() which does not zero memory
memset_s+HcFree pattern used in iso_task_common.c but not here
findings.mitigation: Call memset_s before HcFree for key material buffers
